exposure: amount of proteinuria at time of severe preeclampsia (SPE) diagnosis
cohort: Patients with severe preeclampsia delivering live, non-anomalous singletons between 23 0/7 and 34 2/7 weeks' estimated gestational age, who had proteinuria assessment within 3 days of diagnosis.
finding: Proteinuria level was not consistently associated with the duration of expectant management in patients with severe preeclampsia, though greater amounts of proteinuria were linked to worse neonatal and selected maternal outcomes.
